variants.prompt_v01: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished original vertical 2:3 psychological horror videogame cover poster, high resolution. Game title text verbatim: "心里有鬼" with smaller English "YOUR OWN GHOST". These are the only words. Reference is the uploaded image: use its broad visual language of dark decayed domestic space, photographed mundane surfaces, quiet impossible human scale, obstructed face and murky gray-green tones. Invent a different scene and distinct adult apparition, do not reproduce the source figure or exact composition. Scene: viewed from inside an old Chinese apartment at night, a narrow tall wooden casement window slightly right of center, opaque darkness beyond; a very tall adult humanlike presence in faded brown work clothes stands outside, almost all its face concealed above the lintel, only its pale chin and closed mouth visible in the upper pane, while a single long pale hand rests motionlessly against a lower pane. No violent action. Dirty aged glass reflects a very faint interior bulb. A faded floral curtain hangs at left, modest old plaster wall, perfectly plausible physical details. Its height and the calm placement of its hand generate the dread. Old compact-camera flash photograph fused with restrained painterly retouching, low saturation gray green and umber, true black depths, imperfect soft focus, subtle film grain, humid wood and patina. The pale hand and hidden face must read even at thumbnail size; avoid crushing all midtones. Main artwork upper 78%; title on the lower dark wall with generous margins, four large warm ivory Chinese Song-style serif characters in a single horizontal line; thin widely spaced English beneath. Premium unsettling indie horror cover, graphic restraint, no glossy CGI, no Hollywood montage, no flames, no bloody typography, no gore, no signatures, no logos, no extra text. Single poster, no mockup.
variants.prompt_v02: 请生成一张《心里有鬼》游戏封面，竖版2:3。严格以输入图片为美术风格参考，不是让你把它写实化、高清修复或电影化。用户已明确否定上一批照片一样写实的结果。输入图最重要的特征：灰黑污绿的模糊色块，粗糙干笔和不均匀的涂抹，物体边缘忽清忽糊，平涂与刮擦叠加，故意笨拙僵硬的造型，歪斜的不稳定透视，像阴湿墙面上画出来的恐怖油画或低清数字绘画。看上去是人画的怪诞图，不是相机拍到的真人。怪人的脸有木偶或旧泥塑的迟钝感，泛灰发白的空眼睛，表情空白，解剖比例不协调，身体被建筑遮挡。色彩仅灰黑、灰绿、骨白以及一小块脏赭红。不表现毛孔、皮肤血管、衣物纤维、镜头散景、真实镜面反射；不使用电影灯光、体积光、漂亮轮廓光、摄影闪光灯、PBR或3D渲染。整个画面统一粗粝而平面的绘画质地，主次可读，黑处由笔触叠成。不要漂亮的长发女鬼，不要欧美奇幻插画，不要精细概念设定图，不要照片滤镜。只借鉴附件的笔触、造型和色调，构图与人物重新设计。海报底部留出自然灰黑暗部，中文标题准确为“心里有鬼”，大字浅灰骨白，粗糙旧印刷宋体，四字一行；小号英文“YOUR OWN GHOST”在下方。标题不要发光；不要其他文字、签名或水印。画面：一扇斜歪的旧灰绿木窗占画面大部分，窗格大小不规则。一名头颅偏小、脖子似乎消失的成年怪人穿脏赭红上衣站在窗后。脸只从右上小窗格露出，圆钝苍白，两个淡白眼球向观者凝视；横向窗框遮掉下半张脸；左下格只有一只下垂得过长的手，灰白而简单，衣服躯干在黑暗里只是一团赭红色块。窗框大片干刷灰绿，剥落墙面用粗笔带过。静静站着，不做惊吓姿势。空间扁平，恐怖来自遮挡与人形比例。不要沿用参考的完全相同窗格布局。
